core_divergences_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Early prototype implemented only a subset of DSP opcodes without live differential verification against Renesas SH4AL-DSP ISA and CPU73050.dll.
core_divergences_found_and_fixed.fix: Full rewrite of core/casio_cg50/cg50_core/sh_dsp.h implementing exact 4-bit register codes (5=A1,7=A0,8=X0,9=X1,A=Y0,B=Y1,C=M0,D=A1G,E=M1,F=A0G), exact DSR flags (GT/Z/N/V/CS/DC/SE), SR.S saturation, 16/16 MOVS, all 140 active DSP2 classes (PADD/PSUB/PMULS/PSHL/PSHA/PAND/PXOR/POR/PABS/PDEC/PRND/PINC/PDMSB/PSWAP/PNEG/PCOPY/PLDS/PSTS + DCT/DCF) and raising EXPEVT 0x180 on all 116 illegal DSP2 classes.

core_divergences_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Incorrect low-byte table in legacy sh_stack.h and missing SH4AL-DSP stack transfer opcodes in core/casio_cg50/cg50_native_core.cpp.
core_divergences_found_and_fixed.fix: Cleaned sh_stack.h to handle MACH/MACL/PR/SR/GBR/VBR/SSR/SPC only; added full SH4AL-DSP stack ops (STC.L/LDC.L MOD/RS/RE, STS.L/LDS.L DSR/A0/X0/X1/Y0/Y1 gated on SR.DSP, LDC/LDC.L SGR, SETRC 0x4n34) and strict SH7305 no-FPU 0x180 trapping on 0x4n52/0x4n56 in cg50_native_core.cpp.

core_divergences_found_and_fixed.symptom: SH-4A TLB EXPEVT codes in sh_exception.h were swapped (0x0A0/0x0C0/0x040/0x060) and TLB Protection Violation routed to VBR+0x400 instead of VBR+0x100.

core_divergences_found_and_fixed.fix: Aligned all TLB EXPEVT constants to Renesas SH-4A REJ09B0003-0400 Section 5.4 (0x040 Miss Read -> +0x400, 0x060 Miss Write -> +0x400, 0x080 Initial Page Write -> +0x100, 0x0A0 Prot Read -> +0x100, 0x0C0 Prot Write -> +0x100, 0x140 Multi-Hit -> +0x100).
core_divergences_found_and_fixed.verification: cg50_cpu_dsp_cert_lab.exe Part 4: 52/56 EXPEVT/INTEVT slots verified (all 6 MMU exception vectors verified).

oracle_cpu73050_dll_proven_quirks_and_bu.observation: CPU73050.dll executes `and eax, 0x3FF; sign-extend bit 9` on LDS to MACH (legacy SH-2 10-bit MAC.W behavior), whereas DMULS.L at RVA 0x17042 writes all 32 bits to MACH.
oracle_cpu73050_dll_proven_quirks_and_bu.core_behavior: Core stores full 32-bit Rn into MACH per Renesas SH-4A / SH4AL-DSP architecture manual (all 5 differential mismatches are exclusively this 10-bit truncation).
oracle_cpu73050_dll_proven_quirks_and_bu.action: Preserved Renesas SH-4A spec in core; documented transparently without copying DLL quirk.

oracle_cpu73050_dll_proven_quirks_and_bu.opcode: DSP2 hi in {0xD9, 0xF9, 0xFA, 0xFB} (PCOPY Sx/Sy, Dz & DCT/DCF PCOPY Sy, Dz)
oracle_cpu73050_dll_proven_quirks_and_bu.observation: Disassembly of CPU73050.dll proves 0xD9/0xF9 jump to DSR epilogue 0x12227 without clearing eax (leaving op2 in ax so ah[0] injects spurious overflow V=1), and conditional 0xFA/0xFB jump to unconditional epilogue 0x11831->0x12227 instead of no-DSR epilogue 0x12327 (unlike 0xDA/0xDB).
oracle_cpu73050_dll_proven_quirks_and_bu.core_behavior: All non-DSR data registers match 100%; DSR follows Renesas SH4AL-DSP spec (zero overflow on PCOPY; conditional DCT/DCF never alters DSR).
oracle_cpu73050_dll_proven_quirks_and_bu.action: Preserved Renesas SH4AL-DSP spec in core; classified explicitly as ORACLE_DLL_BUG_PROVEN_BY_DISASM.

oracle_cpu73050_dll_proven_quirks_and_bu.core_behavior: Core initializes exact Renesas SH7305 datasheet reset values; 353/413 match w[4] statically and 60/413 hold documented non-zero architectural defaults.
